chunks: Of no avail shall be his wealth, nor what he has acquired.
ai.seo_question: What happens to a person's wealth and earnings on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse underscores the ultimate futility of material wealth and human effort when facing divine reckoning, a theme central to Shia eschatology regarding the transient nature of dunya. It serves as a reminder that salvation depends on faith and righteous deeds rather than accumulated riches, echoing the Prophetic tradition that wealth is a test rather than a guarantee of favor.
